name: (05) Thaumaturgy (Path of Blood) — 3 Advanced — Cauldron of Blood

system.description:
The most feared of the Path's arts brings a victim's blood to a rolling boil within their own body; red mist rises as bubbling vitae seeps from every pore and orifice, and few mortals survive the internal furnace.

As your action, make a Physical Challenge to grasp your target. For each Mental Trait you expend, up to three, you boil one Blood Trait in the victim's system (limited by their actual blood), and each Blood Trait boiled inflicts one level of aggravated damage. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
